en: Mount Pulag is the highest mountain in Luzon, whereas Mount Apo is the highest peak in the entire Philippines.
The Philippines actually consists of 7,641 islands, as updated by the National Mapping and Resource Information Authority, not 7,107.
Taal Volcano is located on Volcano Island in the middle of Taal Lake, not directly on the Batangas mainland.
The Cagayan River is the longest river in the Philippines at 505 kilometers, not the much shorter Pasig River.
Davao City is the largest city in the Philippines by land area, while Manila is simply the most densely populated.
The Philippine eagle is not exclusive to Mindanao, as it also inhabits the forests of Luzon, Samar, and Leyte.
Palawan is administratively part of the Mimaropa region in Luzon, not the Visayas island group as many mistakenly believe.
Laguna de Bay is the largest lake in the Philippines, while Lake Lanao is only the second largest.
Unlike temperate countries with four seasons, the Philippines only experiences two main seasons: the dry season and the rainy season.
Mount Pulag has a cool temperate climate, making it much colder than the tropical lowlands of the rest of the Philippines.
The Chocolate Hills in Bohol are made of grass-covered limestone formations, not actual chocolate, turning brown only during the dry season.
The Philippine Sea is located on the eastern side of the archipelago, facing the Pacific Ocean, not the western side.
